decisions.diagnosis: Near-zero counts in both directions at 207 and at adjacent 205 while more distant counters were normal, which suggests a local path closure (real traffic loss), not a counter fault; S was kept but N set missing.
decisions.evidence: 207 S 48/7/9 and N 55/7/10 raw on 8-10 Apr (usual ~250-350); 205 48/48, 9/18, 16/21; 198 and 176 normal (~300-400); both directions still register occasional bikes at matching times.

summary: One Metrocount piezo counter with two directions from June 2021 to September 2026, one record per slot, directions tracking each other closely (S/N ratio ~1.1-1.4) and with no doubling or level faults. The single-direction surges on 16 Oct 2022 and 12 Oct 2025 (2005 and 2691 southbound, 08:00-11:00 Sunday) also appear at 205 and 198, so they are an organised ride and are kept; the 20 Oct 2025 all-zero day matches a network-wide outage and its automatic fix stands. Several zero_outage fixes hit one direction only on days when both directions and the neighbouring counters were genuinely very low (weather, and a local closure in April 2026), so those are restored.
